
{{alias}}( options )
    Returns a scale instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    options: Object
        Options.

    options.domain: Collection|Object|Signal (optional)
        Domain of associated data values.

    options.domainMax: number (optional)
        Maximum value in the scale domain (overrides the `domain` option).

    options.domainMin: number (optional)
        Minimum value in the scale domain (overrides the `domain` option).

    options.domainMid: number (optional)
        Single mid-point value inserted into a two-element domain.

    options.domainRaw: Collection (optional)
        Array of raw domain values which overrides the `domain` property.

    options.interpolate: string|Object (optional)
        Scale range interpolation method.

    options.name: string
        Scale name.

    options.range: Collection|Object|Signal|string (optional)
        Scale range.

    options.reverse: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether to reverse the order of the scale range.
        Default: false.

    options.round: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether to round numeric output values to integers.
        Default: false.

    options.type: string (optional)
        Scale type. Default: 'linear'.

    Returns
    -------
    scale: Scale
        Scale instance.

    scale.domain
        Scale domain.

    scale.domainMax
        Explicit scale domain maximum value.

    scale.domainMid
        Mid-point inserted into a two-element scale domain.

    scale.domainMin
        Explicit scale domain minimum value.

    scale.domainRaw
        Raw scale domain values.

    scale.interpolate
        Scale range interpolation method.

    scale.name
        Scale name.

    scale.properties
        List of enumerable properties.

    scale.range
        Scale range.

    scale.reverse
        Boolean indicating whether to reverse the order of the scale range.

    scale.round
        Boolean indicating whether to round numeric output value to integers.

    scale.type
        Scale type.

    scale.toJSON()
        Serializes a scale instance to a JSON object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var scale = new {{alias}}( { 'name': 'xScale' } )
    <Scale>
    > scale.name
    'xScale'

    // Set a property:
    > scale.type = 'log';
    > scale.type
    'log'

    // Serialize to JSON:
    > scale.toJSON()
    { 'name': 'xScale', 'reverse': false, 'round': false, 'type': 'log' }

    --------
